committedBefore: any request to the hosts below; any reading of these pages by PEE; any reference annotation
owner: S80 (skill references/owner-r3-consolidation-2026-10-19.md): priority 3 independent end-to-end validation, priority 4 targeted fixes; exit criteria C3 and C4 (roadmap R3-C)

frozenBuild.rule: every first run executes a git worktree of this commit; harness scripts may be added later but only call existing operational functions and never change algorithms or knowledge resources

sets.D: diagnostic: run once on the frozen build (first run, committed unchanged); its failures guide the S80-4 fixes
sets.H: held back: pages fetched with D but their reference is sealed and NO PEE output on them is produced or looked at until the S80-4 fixes are committed; then run once with the frozen build and once with the fixed build (C4)

sourceSelection.by: Claude (PEE has no configured search service: Phase223 needs an operator SearXNG endpoint). This is a limit of the path, reported as such, never as PEE capability.
sourceSelection.how: web search restricted to the three hosts; selection on result titles and URLs. The search tool also returned short summaries of some pages' content, so the selection was not blind to content (recorded).
sourceSelection.novelty: every URL is absent from the store and from every committed or private evaluation file (982 URLs checked); products absent from the store's 200 products by name and model (one candidate, Instant Vortex Plus Dual Drawer, and one Ninja AF300 page were replaced for that reason)

budget.planned: 3 robots.txt + 12 pages = 15 (3 spare for redirects or a failure)

retention: page bytes only in the private evaluation directory (never Git); PEE's own ingestion only into a COPY of the store; nothing ingested into the live store during S80-3

reference.author: a fresh-context agent of the developer model family, given the page text and the requests, never any PEE output: same-model annotation, NOT independent human validation
reference.sealed: SHA-256 of the reference file committed before the first run of the set it covers
perRequest: goals the user wants (outcomes and stated limits)
evidence that would establish each goal, and known proxies
correct decision type given the evidence on the pages: justified ranking | labelled partial comparison | precise missing evidence
perPage: sampled values: printed text, product, kind (independent test measurement | manufacturer or retailer declaration | estimate or calculation | not a result: setting, price, tariff, range, hypothetical)
test conditions stated for each measurement

stages.S1_goals: needs and limits recognised vs reference (recall, precision)
stages.S2_evidence_needed: the advice names the measurements that would establish each goal and rejects the reference's proxies
stages.S3_reading: reference values found by PEE's readers on the pages (sampled recall)
stages.S4_attribution: found values attributed to the correct product (wrong-product count)
stages.S5_classification: found values classified as the reference does (measurement vs declaration vs not a result); validation accepts only valid measurements
stages.S6_decision: decision type equals the reference's; when no ranking, the stated missing evidence matches the reference's

firstFailingStage: per request, the earliest stage below the reference
tiers: T2 authentic controlled: authentic pages, real components, store copy, any catalog signed with an ephemeral evaluation key; requests 5 of 6 and sources chosen by Claude, reference by the same model family: not author-independent
c4: after S80-4 fixes: H run once with the frozen build and once with the fixed build; success = a better end-to-end outcome on H by the stage scores, with no new wrong-product attribution and no new unjustified conclusion; otherwise R3 stays open and the result is reported as it is
